prompt:
STYLE TEST — TWO PANELS SIDE BY SIDE, divided by a thin clean vertical line at the middle.

★★ STRICTLY 2D FLAT GRAPHIC ART — a scanned flat drawing, NOT a photograph of a drawing on a desk. No perspective, no depth of field, no blur, no studio light, no table, no pencil lying around, no hands, no desk edge, no shadow of the paper. A completely flat scanned image.

TECHNIQUE — WAX CRAYON AND OIL PASTEL ON ROUGH PAPER. Grainy, waxy strokes where the tooth of the paper breaks through the pigment leaving white speckle; visible directional stroke marks and blunt crayon tips; colours slightly unevenly burnished; edges of shapes are chunky and soft and hand-drawn, never inked; areas of hatching where a second colour is rubbed over the first. It should feel like a child's drawing made by a very skilled adult.

PALETTE: deep prussian blue, crimson, ochre, sap green, warm white crayon for highlights, black crayon for the darkest accents.

LEFT PANEL — CHARACTER CARD: a front-facing bust of the man from image 1, drawn in crayon — his wavy hair and forehead cowlick as heavy prussian-blue and dark brown crayon strokes, the full beard as dense dark crayon scumble, the eyebrows thick blunt strokes, the eyes two small white crayon dots with dark pupils, the skin as soft ochre-pink burnished crayon, the white t-shirt as light warm-white crayon with ochre shadow strokes. A hand-drawn crayon rectangle frames him and an empty warm-white strip sits below with no text.

RIGHT PANEL — GAME SCENE, SIDE-SCROLLING: the SAME man as a crayon figure, strict side profile facing right, three to four heads tall, compact body, standing on a flat crayon ledge. Behind him a gothic castle drawn in crayon: a tall pointed arch in prussian blue, a crimson tower with an ochre conical roof, three candle flames in ochre and crimson, and along the ground many separate crayon grass tufts in sap green, densely scattered at varied heights. Two flat horizontal ledges. A dark crayon bat hangs from the arch.

★ VALUE HIERARCHY (mandatory): the SKY / upper background must be the BRIGHTEST — nearly bare warm cream paper with only the faintest crayon haze. The CHARACTER must be the DARKEST mass — heavy dense dark crayon. He reads as a dark silhouette against a pale sky. Do not fill the sky with colour.

★ DEPTH BY SATURATION AND STROKE DENSITY ONLY: far shapes are pale, thin, desaturated crayon scribbles; near shapes are heavily burnished and saturated. No blur, no perspective, no vanishing point.

FRAMING: both panels equally framed, no border around the whole image.
NO TEXT, no letters, no numbers, no signature, no watermark, no logo.

A hand-drawn CRAYON sprite sheet: ONE horizontal row of exactly 6 frames showing the SAME character walking, a 6-step walk cycle loop. The identical character must repeat in all 6 cells — same face, same hair, same clothes, same size. Evenly spaced along the row, all 6 pairs of feet resting on the same invisible ground line, strict side view facing right, full body including feet, 3.3 heads tall adult proportions.

Character (same as reference image): a man in his early 30s with thick dark-brown curly hair and a full beard, wearing a plain white t-shirt, brown knee-length shorts, brown shoes. No weapon, empty hands.

Frame poses in order: 1) front heel strikes, back heel lifting 2) weight shifting onto front leg 3) back leg swings through, knee raised 4) back heel strikes (mirror of 1) 5) weight shifting onto back leg 6) front leg swings through.

Medium: real wax crayon on warm cream paper. Waxy, slightly broken color with the cream paper showing through at the edges; irregular hand-drawn contour of about 3px; no perfectly straight lines; no smooth vector curves. Flat 2D graphic art. Palette strictly limited to: cream #E8DCBE paper, charcoal #2B2320, cool grey #8C8B84, umber #6B4B32, skin #D9A16B, wax white #FBF7EC.

Background: plain flat cream paper only, no scenery.

STRICTLY NOT: no photograph, no photo of real paper cards, no paper texture overlay photo, no 3D render, no perspective or vanishing point, no drop shadow, no soft shadow, no gradient shading, no pixel art, no dithering, no clean vector linework, no text, no numbers, no labels, no grid lines, no borders, no watermark.

A hand-drawn CRAYON walk-cycle sprite sheet, ONE horizontal row of EXACTLY 6 complete adult figures.

CRITICAL LAYOUT RULES: exactly 6 figures, no more, no fewer. Each figure is a COMPLETE person with two legs, two arms, a torso and a head — absolutely no detached limbs, no floating legs, no cropped body parts, no figure missing a leg. Six equal-width invisible columns, one figure centered in each column, uniform gaps between them. All six pairs of shoes rest on exactly the SAME horizontal ground line.

PROPORTIONS: adult body, 3.3 heads tall — the head (including hair) is about 30% of total height. NOT chibi, NOT super-deformed, NOT a big-head cartoon. Same size in all six cells.

Character (identical to the reference): man in his early 30s, thick dark-brown curly hair, full beard, plain white t-shirt, brown shorts down to the knee, brown shoes. Strict side view, facing right. Empty hands, no weapon.

Frame poses: 1) front heel strikes, back heel lifting 2) weight over front leg, back leg trailing 3) back leg swings through with knee raised, single supporting leg 4) back heel strikes, front heel lifting 5) weight over back leg, front leg trailing 6) front leg swings through with knee raised.

3) CONTACT MIRRORED: legs scissored wide open the other way, back foot forward now.
4) PASSING UP MIRRORED: legs together again, the OTHER knee lifted HIGH and bent sharply, body at its highest point.
